title: I’M YOUR DJ – KIZOMBA NEW YEAR
description:
🤎 I’M YOUR DJ – KIZOMBA NEW YEAR 🤎
———— Next Chapter ————
🇬🇧 📅 December 30–31, 2026 / January 1–2, 2027
📍 Paris Marriott Rive Gauche Hotel & Conference Center – Paris
⸻
💛 4 days – 1 hotel – 1 experience in the heart of Paris.
✨ An all-in-one experience: a 4-day Kizomba immersion designed as a true winter cocoon. Everything happens on site, in an elegant and welcoming venue. You arrive, drop your bags… and simply enjoy.

🤎 IMPORTANT INFORMATION 🤎
🔁 Name change / ticket resale
If you can’t attend, your ticket is transferable.
Name changes must be done only through the ticketing system, with a 20€ fee.
🎟️ Wristbands & access
Please collect your wristband at the event reception upon presentation of:
* your Weezevent ticket
* a valid ID
🧥 Cloakroom
* Mandatory cloakroom on site
(except shoe bags and light jackets)
* Fee: 2€ per person
⸻
🤎 VENUE 🤎
Paris Marriott Rive Gauche Hotel & Conference Center
17 Boulevard Saint-Jacques – 75014 Paris
➡️ Access:
* Guests with hotel rooms: main hotel entrance
* Guests without hotel rooms: Conference Center entrance
⸻
🤎 PARKING 🤎
🚗 Parking information in Paris:
* Free every night from 8PM to 9AM
* Free all day on January 1st (public holiday)
* Paid during daytime on Dec 31 & Jan 2
📍 Street parking is usually available around the venue.
For cheaper secured parking, use:
Zenpark • Yespark • Onepark • Indigo Neo
⸻
🤎 HOW TO GET THERE 🤎
🚇 Metro line 6 – Glacière or Saint-Jacques (2-minute walk)
✈️ From CDG Airport – approx. 50 min
RER B → Denfert-Rochereau → Metro 6 → Glacière → 2 min walk
✈️ From ORY Airport – approx. 45 min
Orlyval → Antony → RER B → Denfert-Rochereau → Metro 6 → Glacière → 2 min walk
🚆 From Gare Montparnasse – approx. 15 min
Metro 6 → Glacière → 2 min walk
🚆 From Gare de Lyon – approx. 20 min
Metro 14 → Bercy → Metro 6 → Glacière → 2 min walk
